competitors.title: FDIC Chairman Hill: There's a lot of promise and benefits from tokenized deposits and tokenization m
competitors.description:
FDIC Chairman Hill: There's a lot of promise and benefits from tokenized deposits and tokenization more broadly—being able to settle immediately, improve collateral management, remove frictions from cross-border payments, and build in conditionality into smart contracts.

In terms of the rulemaking @FDICgov is working on, the actual regulatory change we're looking at is focused on a principle I've talked about in the past: the technology or record-keeping used with respect to a deposit shouldn't change the legal status of something as a deposit.
